name: ReCoRD
description: Reading Comprehension with Commonsense Reasoning Dataset (ReCoRD) is a large-scale reading comprehension benchmark requiring commonsense reasoning. Given a news article and a Cloze-style question with a masked entity, models select the correct entity from a list of entity candidates extracted from the article. Tests commonsense knowledge about events.
reputation: Component of SuperGLUE; large-scale commonsense reading comprehension; sourced from CNN/Daily Mail news articles; human performance ~91.7 F1
notes: Introduced at EMNLP 2018. Contains ~121K query-answer pairs from ~80K news articles. Part of SuperGLUE benchmark. The Cloze-style setup involves filling in named entities—the answer is always an entity span from the article. Requires understanding news article context and commonsense reasoning about events.
